newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Agriculture Bank extended loans worth 28.5 billion riyals since it was set up 20 years ago.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan inaugurates a medical centre in Mecca, donates 10 million riyals.
- Saudi investors to set up a new tourism company in the eastern province city of Ahsa.
- Ministers urge moves to unite trade regulations in Gulf Arab states.
